calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-29-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and a Minor
Comm. Sue M. Kaplan, Clerk: M. Vallejo, Reporter: Karen Farnsworth

Petitioner: Vanessa Damian, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for /and with/ the Minor: Vanessa Damian, was sworn and examined.
Alvio Calmerin the minor's father consents to the name change and signs the petition in open court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.

It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Adult's Name to: Vanessa Damian Calmerin.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Gabriella Malia Damian Calmerin.

Decree signed in open court.
